value.name: Dawn's Return
value.desc:
Varka: Dawn's Return

"I'm sure it's painfully obvious to every reader by now, but the 'Witch Certification and Final Trial' mentioned in Volume 1 of the original work can only be taken by children who wish to become great witches. In other words, you can't have a 'Witch Certification Exam' without witches. Surely no one would use the certification exam as an excuse to give themselves a task they've already completed just to go around swindling people out of free drinks, right?"

value.text: Reward for inviting Varka to a duel at The Cat's Tail and claiming victory in a Friendly Fracas with him

value.name: Varka
value.desc: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Knight of Boreas, protector of Mondstadt.

desc.text:
<color=#ffd680>Elemental Skill</color>
Deals 1 <color=#80ffd6>Anemo DMG</color> and attaches Sturm und Drang to self. If you have any Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo characters on the field, this character gains the corresponding Elemental Infusion, prioritized in that order.
<color=#ebe4d8>Sturm und Drang</color>
<color=#ffd680>Status</color>
<color=#ffffff>After the attached character uses a Normal Attack:</color> Deal 1 <color=#80ffd7>Anemo DMG</color> .
<color=#ffffff>Duration (Rounds)</color> : 2
<color=#ffffff>After the attached character has used Normal Attacks twice:</color> Create <color=#ffffff>Windbound Execution</color> .
<color=#ebe4d8>Windbound Execution</color>
Select 1 Skill for Varka. At the start of the next Round, remove 1 die, switch to Varka, and prepare the corresponding Skill:
Deal 6 <color=#80ffd6>Anemo DMG</color> .
Or:
Apply the corresponding Elemental Infusion based on the elements attached to your characters. Then perform 2 Normal Attacks.

<color=#ffd680>Elemental Burst</color>
Deals 3 <color=#80ffd7>Anemo DMG</color> . If you have any Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo characters on the field, this DMG is converted to the corresponding Elemental DMG, prioritized in that order. After this Skill ends, deal an additional 2 <color=#80ffd7>Anemo DMG</color> .

Reacts with Elements if they are already applied:
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Cryo Swirl</color> : Deals 1 Cryo DMG to all opposing chracters except the target
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Hydro Swirl:</color> Deals 1 Hydro DMG to all opposing characters except the target
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Pyro Swirl</color> : Deals 1 Pyro DMG to all opposing characters except the target
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Electro Swirl</color> : Deals 1 Electro DMG to all opposing characters except the target

<color=#ebe4d8>Physical DMG</color>
Physical DMG will not apply any Elements, nor can it engage in Elemental Reactions.
<color=#ebe4d8>Duration (Rounds)</color>
Each time you reach the end of a Round, <color=#ffffff>Duration (Rounds)</color> -1.
This card will be discarded immediately once <color=#ffffff>Duration (Rounds)</color> runs out.

customize.desc: Currency verified and used by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Can be used to purchase various items related to Genius Invokation TCG. It is said that these coins were initially named as such in the hopes that they would bring those carrying them luck. However, perhaps it is those who are sufficiently lucky who are able to possess them...
